jobs.title: Implementation Manager – Spend/ERP
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

### **How you'll make impact**

Own the end-to-end delivery of complex Spend and corporate card implementations for enterprise and high-growth customers across the US, turning agreed business requirements and solution designs into actionable plans that land on time, on scope, and to a high quality bar.

Act as a trusted technical advisor across high-value implementations and expansions, shaping integration approaches, system configuration, solution design, and the use of ERP, HRIS, API, and third-party connector integrations. You’ll work closely with Sales, Merchant Services, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, Risk, activation and onboarding teams, account management, and external partners including networks, processors, and manufacturers.

Lead technical discovery, understand customer systems, data flows, and workflows, and guide customers through complex configuration decisions and integration hurdles. You’ll focus on robust, maintainable implementations rather than writing code directly, while serving as a subject matter expert on the wider integration ecosystem.

Create documentation, playbooks, and lightweight tooling that help the wider team support integration-heavy use cases at scale. You’ll also channel customer pain points and integration feedback into Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap priorities that materially improve implementation outcomes.

You'll work from our SF office three days a week, with implementation coverage across the US.

### **What we're looking for**

**Essentials**

* A bachelor’s degree in a related field such as Business, Finance, Engineering, or Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, customer success, or project or program management, managing complex, multi-stakeholder technology or financial services implementations.
* 4+ years of client-facing delivery or professional services experience in a fast-paced environment such as SaaS, fintech, consulting, systems integration, or enterprise implementation.
* A track record of successfully delivering cross-functional projects with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds and job functions, including C-level executives, technical teams, and operations.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead steering meetings, write clear status updates, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Experience delivering ERP, accounting system, or expense platform implementations, such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Xero, including associated data flows such as GL, cost centres, entities, and card feeds.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience working with or alongside integration engineers, solution architects, or technical program managers on API-based integrations, including familiarity with common web, SSO, and ERP integration concepts.
* Formal training or certification in project management or agile delivery, such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Scrum Master, and comfort setting up operating rhythms such as stand-ups, steering committees, and executive readouts.
* Experience managing strategic or enterprise accounts as part of a broader account team, including navigating commercial sensitivities while protecting delivery quality and scope.
* The ability to thrive in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment, balancing structured methodologies with pragmatic decision-making to keep complex projects moving forward.

### **You'll thrive here if**

* You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.
* You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.
* You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.
* You over-communicate by design. You’d rather flag something early than let it become a surprise.
* You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn’t a way to avoid accountability.

### **Learn more about your team**

Merchant Services at Airwallex is made up of two teams: Solutions Engineering and Technical Support, working together to turn customer-facing technical work into product progress. Across both teams, we help businesses design, integrate, launch, optimize, and scale on Airwallex's global financial infrastructure, covering solution architecture, delivery, technical account management, optimisation, and support.

The mandate is simple: solve for the customer in front of us, and build for the customers we haven't met yet. Sitting close to Product, Engineering, and Design means the patterns you see in real customer integrations can become better APIs, documentation, tooling, onboarding paths, and product capabilities. The hard part is doing both at once: shipping for today's customer without losing the signal that improves the product for the next.

This is a team for people who can earn trust with builders, reason through complex systems, communicate clearly, and stay grounded in commercial outcomes. If you want to work at the intersection of agentic finance, customer impact, and product development, this is where your work compounds.

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters**
-------------------------------------------------------------

*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

*Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Compensation Range: $150K - $250K

jobs.title: Onboarding Associate
jobs.description:
**About AirGarage**

AirGarage is on a mission to bring real estate online, starting with parking.

We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more.

By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. That’s why national real‑estate leaders like Hines and Greystar, as well as technology companies like Meta, partner with AirGarage to optimize their parking facilities.

AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time.

We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before.

Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online.

We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking.

We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more.  
  
Want to learn more about AirGarage and the problem we're tackling?
  
  
Check out these podcasts:
  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4  
https://youtu.be/\_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7

**THE ROLE**

We’re looking for an Onboarding Specialist with a proven track record of building and scaling predictable, repeatable processes that support growth without requiring headcount to increase at the same pace. You’ll bring that experience to AirGarage to help us deliver exceptional onboarding as we grow.

You’ll own the end-to-end onboarding experience for new AirGarage partners, from the moment a deal closes through the go-live date. As the main point of contact for property owners, tenants, internal teams, and vendors, you’ll orchestrate a smooth transition to our platform-building trust and setting each location up for long-term success.

This highly cross-functional role sits at the intersection of Sales, Operations, Hardware, Product, and Partner Success. It calls for meticulous organization, excellent communication, and a commitment to both an exceptional partner experience and scalable operations.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Own the Launch Process for New Properties:**

* Act as the primary owner for new locations onboarding, from the moment a deal is closed through handing them off to our regional operations team post go-live.
* Develop and execute detailed onboarding plans tailored to each property.
* Coordinate across hardware, permitting, compliance, and central ops teams to ensure all launch dependencies are met.

**Be the Point of Contact for Partners and Stakeholders:**

* Serve as the main liaison for property owners, tenants, and other stakeholders throughout the onboarding process.
* Proactively manage communications and set clear expectations around timelines and deliverables.
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with partners by providing timely updates, solving issues quickly, and anticipating needs.

**Drive Internal Execution and Accountability:**

* Ensure that all internal teams involved in onboarding are aligned and working toward the same goals.
* Surface blockers, escalate issues, and solve problems in real time to keep projects on track.
* Implement and refine playbooks to improve onboarding speed, consistency, and quality.

**Measure and Improve the Onboarding Experience:**

* Gather feedback from partners and internal teams to continuously improve the process.
* Work with leadership to scale the onboarding function and build a repeatable, scalable system.
* Identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the onboarding workflow and implement process improvements to increase speed, consistency, and reliability across all launches.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to document and standardize best practices, creating internal playbooks and SOPs that ensure a repeatable, scalable onboarding process.

**Create and Refine Client-Facing Onboarding Materials:**

* Develop high-quality onboarding collateral, including welcome packets, training guides, transition checklists, and FAQs tailored to various partner types.
* Continuously improve the clarity, consistency, and professionalism of all client-facing materials to ensure they reflect AirGarage’s brand and values.
* Work with design, marketing, and product teams to align messaging across platforms and touch points during the onboarding phase.
* Incorporate partner feedback to iterate and enhance the materials used throughout the onboarding journey.
* Maintain a library of up-to-date templates and resources that can be easily customized and scaled as AirGarage grows.

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* 1+ years of experience in onboarding, partner success, implementation, project management, or operations, ideally in a fast-paced startup or tech-enabled services environment.
* Willingness to travel to new location launches (roughly 30% travel).
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills—you are equally comfortable working with external stakeholders and internal technical teams.
* Strong project management skills, with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful outcomes.
* Ability to think critically, solve problems proactively, and stay calm under pressure.
* A genuine desire to create great experiences for partners and internal teams alike.

**Note**: Employment with AirGarage is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and employment verification conducted in compliance with applicable laws. Background checks are completed only after a conditional offer of employment has been made.

*We understand that there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for someone passionate, with grit and determination, who is excited to face the challenges of a rapidly growing startup. AirGarage is the type of company where you can grow exponentially, and we encourage you to apply to us even if you don't 100% match the candidate description.*

AirGarage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

Compensation Range: $80K - $100K

jobs.title: Commission-Based Promoter & Onboarding Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description:
Star Riff is a browser-based 3D space exploration game and music experience. Players fly freely through space, ride creatures, ships, skateboard, surf, explore planets, hidden realms, collect gems, and meet other players online. Our signature **Saber Surfing** mode lets players battle each other on towering tsunami waves. It runs right in the browser with no download, and it works on mobile.

Music is at the heart of the universe. Featured artists' releases live on navigable planets, and **artists can apply to play live shows at in-game venues across different planets**, performing for players from around the world.

**We already have 2,000+ monthly users, and we're just getting started.** We're looking for partners to help bring thousands more into the universe, along with the artists who make it sing.

The Role

We're looking for energetic promoters and onboarding assistants to grow our community on two fronts: **players** and **artists**. You'll introduce Star Riff to new audiences, guide new players through sign-up, convert enthusiastic players into **Pro users**, and help musicians discover and apply for in-game venue shows. You'll earn a **commission on every sign-up you bring in**.

Responsibilities

* Promote Star Riff across social media, gaming communities, music communities, skate and surf communities, and online forums
* Drive new account sign-ups through your own outreach and networks
* Welcome new players and help them get started and feel at home
* Encourage engaged players to upgrade to Pro
* **Recruit artists, bands, and DJs to apply for in-game venue shows, and help them through the application and placement process**
* Coordinate with the Star Riff team to secure show placements across different planets
* Share player and artist feedback and ideas with the team
* Use your unique referral link or code so your sign-ups are tracked

What We're Looking For

* Passion for gaming, space themes, music, skate or surf culture, or creative web experiences
* Strong communication skills, written and verbal
* Comfort with social platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, and Discord
* Comfortable reaching out to musicians, managers, and promoters
* Self-motivated and able to work independently
* Friendly, approachable, and good at explaining things simply
* *Nice to have:* experience in community management, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, music promotion, booking, or game promotion

Compensation

* **Commission:** % of every sign-up you bring in
* **Pro upgrades:** % / bonus for each referred user who upgrades to Pro
* **Artist placements:** % / $ for each artist you bring in who is approved for an in-game show
* Paid monthly via PayPal
* No cap on earnings. The more players and artists you bring in, the more you make.

Why Join Us

* Work from anywhere, on your own schedule
* Promote a product that's different and fun to share: space flight, surfing, skateboarding, saber battles, and live virtual concerts in one game
* Get in early at a growing indie game with a proven audience
* Build relationships with artists and help shape a new kind of music venue
* Direct access to the founder and the chance to shape how we grow
* Opportunity to grow into a larger role as we expand

How to Apply

Send a short message telling us:

* Where you'd promote Star Riff, and any player or artist audiences you already reach
* Links to relevant social profiles or past promotion or booking work, if you have them
* Why you'd be a great fit

**Try the game first:** starriff.com

*Details to be discussed during the onboarding process.*

Pay: $33,800.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

jobs.description:
### **This is a remote role** **Position Details + Benefits**

* $85K base salary. We pay 100% of employee premiums for our base medical, dental, and vision plans

* Remote role. Travel up to four times per year to NYC or other ParentChild+ sites for training, professional development, and other program activities.

* 403(b) - 6% employer match! + FSA + HSA

* High accountability + high flexibility culture

### **About Us**

ParentChild+ is a national early childhood organization founded in 1965. We work with local partners across the country to help families support their children's early learning and prepare them for school. Our National Center provides training, resources, and support to the organizations delivering our programs in their communities.

We have two home visiting models:

* Family Model: Helps parents support their children's learning and development through play, books, and everyday interactions.

* Home-Based Child Care Model: Helps home-based child care providers create engaging learning environments for young children.

At each local site, Coordinators manage the program, train and supervise staff, and support program quality. Early Learning Specialists (ELSs) visit families or child care providers, using books, toys, and play to support children's learning and development.

### **Your Mission**

Your job is to coordinate and co-lead training opportunities for new ParentChild+ Family Model Coordinators and Home Visitors as they prepare to launch a new site. You'll also manage the process of helping new Family Model sites get started from initial planning through onboarding and training.

You'll work closely with our other National Center teams to make sure your training and onboarding run smoothly and that new sites have the support they need to succeed.

### **Responsibilities**

Facilitation, Coaching + Practice Support

* Lead two intensive, six-week training programs each year, along with smaller training sessions throughout the year. You'll train about 25 new Coordinators annually from partner organizations who are learning to bring the Family Model to their communities. Your manager and other trainers will help you prepare and lead these sessions.

* Work with your manager and other teams to prepare and lead training on assessments. You'll receive formal training to prepare you for these sessions, as needed.

* After training, you'll continue working with these Coordinators through a Community of Practice (CoP). You'll lead group meetings every two weeks for seven months, helping Coordinators solve problems, support their Home Visitors, and improve how they run their programs.

* Turn Family Model standards and findings from program evaluations into clear, practical guidance that Coordinators and sites can use in their daily work.

### **Program Management & Operations**

* Manage the New Coordinator Training Institute and Communities of Practice. Work with your manager to set training priorities, coordinate with other trainers, and make sure new Coordinators learn the skills and Family Model standards they need.

* Use program data, evaluation findings, participant feedback, and experience from local sites to identify training needs and improve future training.

* Build and improve administrative processes across departments for training, evaluation, and other activities involving local sites. Coordinate schedules, registration, communications, materials, and recordkeeping so responsibilities are clear and work runs smoothly.

* Maintain and update documents, training materials, and other resources shared with sites on the Staff Portal, working with other departments on updates and translations as needed.

* Develop and coordinate program eBlasts to share training opportunities, evaluation activities, program updates, and other important information with our network.

### **Site Startup + Onboarding**

* Develop and manage a clear, consistent process for helping new Family Model sites get started, working closely with other National Center teams.

* Coordinate the steps involved in opening a new site, including schedules, staff responsibilities, site orientation, and preparation for training. Make sure everyone understands what needs to happen and when.

* Track each new site's progress, identify problems or areas where additional support is needed, and work with State Directors and other teams to help sites get their programs up and running.

### **Qualifications**

* 5+ years' experience in early childhood or family support programs.

* Adult Learning + Facilitation: Experience developing and leading training for adults, including group discussions and activities. Experience with reflective supervision or coaching is a plus.

* Organization + Program Management: Strong organizational skills, including managing schedules, coordinating projects, and keeping multiple activities on track.

* Equitable Orientation: Commitment to strength-based, equity-centered, and culturally responsive practice.

* Technology: Comfortable using Microsoft Office, Zoom, and Management Information Systems (MIS).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* You speak Spanish or another ParentChild+ priority language (e.g., Mandarin, Arabic, or Haitian Creole).

* Basic understanding of data analysis

### **What Success Looks Like in Your First Year**

* New Site Onboarding: Create and document a clear process for starting new sites, including responsibilities, timelines, and what sites need to have in place before launching. Test and improve the process as new sites come on board.

* Program Operations: Improve administrative processes that support work across departments, including site communications, eBlasts, and maintaining Staff Portal resources. Make sure responsibilities and timelines are clear.

* Training Management: Plan and manage two annual training institutes and their Communities of Practice. Keep training organized, meet deadlines, and improve processes to reduce administrative work.

* Training Delivery: Lead engaging training sessions that encourage discussion, reflection, and practical learning. Demonstrate strong facilitation skills through observation and positive participant feedback.

* Coaching + Practice Support: Build coaching skills through training and practice. Gradually take on more responsibility for coaching Coordinators and sites, with support from your manager.

* Training Improvement: Use participant feedback and program data to identify training needs and make a meaningful improvement to foundational training.

jobs.description:
**Onboarding Specialist**

**COREWARE | JOB DESCRIPTION**

Department: Customer Success – Onboarding

Reports to: Implementation & Onboarding Lead

Role focus: End-to-end customer onboarding, launch readiness, training, adoption, and time to value

**Position Summary**

The Onboarding Specialist owns the customer onboarding journey from kickoff through successful launch and handoff. This role guides customers through discovery, account setup, configuration, data readiness, training, testing, and activation of their purchased Coreware solutions. The goal is to help customers go live quickly and correctly, confidently use their essential workflows, and realize value with minimal avoidable post-launch issues. The Onboarding Specialist is accountable for the onboarding outcome—not simply completing tasks or scheduling activities. The Onboarding Specialist executes Coreware’s prescribed onboarding playbooks and uses available product capabilities, standardized workflows, and automation to deliver consistent, high-quality onboarding across the appropriate service levels.

**End-to-End Customer Onboarding Ownership**

* Own assigned customer onboarding journeys from kickoff through successful go-live and transition to ongoing support.
* Create and drive clear onboarding plans, milestones, timelines, customer responsibilities, and success criteria.
* Guide customers through account setup, configuration, applicable data migration, integrations, training, testing, and launch preparation.
* Serve as the customer’s primary onboarding contact; proactively resolve blockers and escalate risks.
* Ensure purchased solutions in the agreed onboarding scope are ready for use; keep customer records and milestones current.

**Onboarding Quality & Launch Readiness**

* Understand customer goals and business workflows, and translate them into accurate, usable Coreware setup.
* Verify that required settings, integrations, applicable data, and critical workflows work as expected before launch.
* Lead readiness checks and hands-on testing to identify and resolve gaps before customers begin live operations.
* Confirm customer teams, workflows, and purchased capabilities are ready for launch; document readiness and open items.
* Prevent avoidable setup issues, confusion, and support escalations after go-live.

**Customer Training & Adoption**

* Deliver practical, role-based onboarding and training for purchased products and day-to-day workflows.
* Tailor guidance to each customer’s operations, team roles, and level of experience.
* Validate learning through demonstrations, practice, and successful completion of key workflows.
* Identify adoption barriers early and provide targeted coaching and resources before launch.
* Ensure customer users can perform essential tasks independently and confidently at go-live.

**Time to Value & Onboarding Efficiency**

* Move customers toward their first meaningful value from Coreware as quickly as practical.
* Actively manage outstanding customer actions, dependencies, and internal support to prevent avoidable delays.
* Apply the prescribed onboarding process consistently while maintaining quality and adapting to customer needs.
* Prioritize the setup, training, and workflows customers need to begin benefiting from their purchased solutions.
* Balance onboarding speed with accurate setup, strong training, and sustainable customer adoption.

**Standardized Onboarding & Process Efficiency**

* Execute onboarding in accordance with Coreware’s prescribed playbooks, processes, and service models, including self-guided, guided, and managed approaches as they are introduced.
* Adjust customer engagement and hands-on assistance to the assigned onboarding approach while maintaining accountability for launch readiness, customer adoption, and onboarding quality.
* Use available product functionality, onboarding tools, automation, and standardized workflows to reduce manual work and accelerate time to value.
* Follow established onboarding milestones, quality standards, training requirements, and launch-readiness checks consistently.
* Identify recurring friction and recommend improvements to playbooks, self-service resources, and product-enabled onboarding efficiencies.

**Customer Communication & Experience**

* Lead onboarding kickoff, progress, training, and launch-readiness conversations with clear next steps.
* Set expectations for timelines, responsibilities, required customer actions, risks, and changes.
* Build customer confidence through proactive guidance, responsiveness, and ownership of the onboarding experience.

**Customer Risk Management, Expectation Setting & Issue Resolution**

* Proactively identify and mitigate onboarding risks, including customer concerns, scope changes, configuration challenges, unmet expectations, and potential delays to go-live.
* Set clear expectations about current product capabilities, agreed onboarding scope, timelines, and the difference between essential launch requirements and future enhancements.
* Guide customers toward existing Coreware functionality, standard workflows, and practical alternatives that meet business needs without unnecessary customization or delay.
* Address objections and de-escalate customer concerns through active listening, clear communication, and solution-oriented recommendations.
* Maintain forward momentum by constructively challenging avoidable delays, reinforcing milestones, and helping customers make informed launch decisions.
* Advocate for legitimate, business-critical customer needs while preventing nonessential enhancement requests from unnecessarily stalling onboarding.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success leadership to evaluate genuine product gaps and escalate critical blockers; do not promise unapproved enhancements or delivery dates.
* Use sound judgment to determine when to recommend current functionality, adjust a workflow, escalate a blocker, or revise an onboarding plan.

**Go-Live Handoff & Continuous Improvement**

* Document customer goals, account setup, training completion, launch status, outstanding items, and known risks.
* Provide a structured handoff to Customer Success and Support, and help resolve onboarding-related early-life issues.
* Review early customer usage and recurring friction to improve onboarding playbooks, readiness checks, and training.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**KPI**

**Measurement**

Time to Value (TTV)

Time from onboarding kickoff to the customer’s first meaningful value from purchased solutions.

Time to Go-Live

Elapsed time from onboarding kickoff to successful production launch, measured against targets.

Onboarding Quality / First-Time-Right

Share of launches without significant preventable setup errors, missing requirements, or readiness gaps.

On-Time Go-Live Rate

Share of customers launched by agreed target dates, accounting for documented dependencies and scope changes.

Post-Launch Onboarding Issue Rate

Onboarding-related support requests, setup problems, or escalations within 30 days of launch.

Customer Adoption & Readiness

Demonstrated ability to use essential workflows and purchased functionality at launch.

Training Effectiveness

Required training completed and customer proficiency demonstrated.

Onboarding Milestone Completion

Timely completion and accurate documentation of onboarding milestones and readiness checks.

Onboarding Satisfaction

Customer feedback on onboarding guidance, communication, training, and launch experience.

Onboarding Productivity

Customers successfully onboarded relative to workload and complexity without sacrificing quality.

Onboarding Risk & Escalation Management

Effectiveness in identifying and resolving risks early, managing customer expectations, and minimizing avoidable delays while escalating genuine launch blockers appropriately.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience in SaaS customer onboarding, software implementation, customer enablement, or a related customer-facing role.
* Ability to independently own multiple customer onboarding journeys from kickoff through successful launch.
* Strong project organization, customer communication, troubleshooting, and attention to detail.
* Experience training software users and translating business needs into effective platform setup.
* Ability to collaborate across Customer Success, Support, Product, and Engineering.
* Experience with onboarding or project tracking tools; familiarity with Coreware products and customer industries is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

Customers complete onboarding efficiently and confidently: their purchased solutions are set up correctly, essential workflows work, and users are trained to operate independently. Successful onboarding means a fast, high-quality launch, early product adoption, and few preventable post-launch issues.

Pay: $25.00 - $28.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Manager (Captain of Go-Live)
jobs.description:
Do you feel more in your element, not less, when a project has six stakeholders, three departments, and a deadline that actually matters to someone's budget? Can you read an RFP or a draft SOW and spot the commitment that will blow up month four of an implementation before anyone has signed anything? Do you get more satisfaction from watching your team land a go-live than from landing it yourself? Can you spot a risk quietly building across two different workstreams, or across five people's portfolios, before anyone else notices it? Do you already reach for AI to move faster through complex data and document work, and coach your team to do the same? Are you the person other teams call when an enterprise account needs someone steady at the helm? If so, keep reading...

The team at RTA is looking for an Implementation Manager: our Enterprise Orchestrator, Team Coach, and Fleet360 Authority all rolled into one. Reporting to the CTO, you'll lead RTA's implementation team of enterprise and non-enterprise Implementation Specialists. You'll own the delivery of every customer onboarding from signed contract through a confident go-live.

You'll hire, coach, and hold accountable the specialists who run every engagement, and step in as the escalation point when an enterprise account needs a steady hand. Your work starts before the contract is signed. You'll partner with Sales during the enterprise pre-sales process to review RFPs, SOWs, and contract language, so that what we promise is something we can actually deliver. You'll coordinate across Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM (Customer Success Management), catch risk across the whole portfolio before it threatens a timeline, and make sure every customer arrives at go-live confident, not just converted. This position plays a direct role in RTA's mission to help fleets succeed, starting with the customers who trust us with the most.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

In general, someone who:

* Feels at home being a member of a healthy team. This means they aren't afraid to mix it up or be held accountable by the team, and they are willing to hold others accountable as well. People with trust issues and insecurity need not apply. No, seriously.
* Passionately cares about our clients and helping them be more successful. Our clients are fleet managers, parts clerks, and automotive technicians who maintain everything from squad cars to school buses so that everyone comes home safely at the end of the day.
* Thinks of themselves less, while not thinking less of themselves. They are other-centric, compassionate, and self-assured.
* Is willing to lift boxes, clean floors, and hold doors if that's what it takes to get something done, because no job is beneath them.
* Takes ownership and initiative. They identify how to make processes better without waiting to be told, and practice Extreme Ownership when things go sideways.
* Loves to read, learn, grow, and stretch themselves through goal setting and daily habits. Bonus points for each book you've read by Patrick Lencioni.
* Wants to be part of a leadership team that constantly challenges and stretches each other's abilities. We don't do echo chambers here.

**Specifically for This Role, Someone Who:**
--------------------------------------------

**Leads and develops the team**

* Has led and managed an implementation, onboarding, or professional services team for a software product, and loves helping others excel in their work.
* Sets clear expectations, runs effective 1:1s, gives direct feedback early, and creates a culture where people grow and do their best work. Part coach, part bulldozer: you seek and destroy the obstacles blocking your team.
* Holds specialists accountable to timelines, quality, and scope, and has the hard conversation when performance isn't there, rather than quietly absorbing the work yourself.
* Recruits, onboards, and retains strong implementers, and builds onboarding plans that get new specialists running implementations on their own quickly.
* Balances workload across the team: assigns new engagements based on capacity and complexity, and sees an overloaded portfolio before it becomes a missed go-live.
* Understands the value of metrics, knows what to track and how to track it, and makes staffing, process, and tooling decisions from the data.

**Reviews enterprise documents before the deal is signed**

* Partners with Sales during the enterprise pre-sales process, reviewing RFPs, SOWs, contracts, and statements of requirements for implementation scope, timeline, data migration, integration, and staffing commitments.
* Reads requirement language line by line and flags anything vague, unrealistic, or out of scope, then proposes the language that fixes it before it becomes a commitment we have to keep.
* Contributes the implementation sections of RFP responses and SOWs: approach, timeline, roles, assumptions, and customer responsibilities.
* Turns the signed documents into the implementation plan, so the team delivers against what was actually contracted, not what someone remembers from the sales call.

**Owns enterprise delivery**

* Owns timeline and sequencing across the team's full implementation portfolio.
* Coordinates explicitly across Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM at defined handoff points, keeping every team's commitments visible instead of assumed.
* Proactively surfaces risk, including cross-departmental dependencies that are quietly stalling, and brings a mitigation plan instead of just a flag.
* Guides customers, including senior fleet and operations leaders, through high-stakes configuration decisions with enough credibility that they trust your judgment, not just your process.
* Builds confidence with enterprise customers by communicating proactively, setting clear expectations, and creating trust long before issues ever arise. You are the escalation point when a customer relationship gets tense.
* Holds the agreed scope line with customers, knowing when a variation needs documentation, an addendum, or a real escalation, and coaches the team to do the same.
* Owns data migration quality across the team. You can clean, compile, and migrate data into Fleet360 yourself, and you're comfortable with nested formulas, multi-condition logic, and multi-tab interconnected workbooks. You also set the standard and review the work so migration errors don't reach go-live.
* Builds and refines implementation processes, playbooks, and templates that scale as the enterprise pipeline grows.
* Operates with an AI-first mindset and makes the team AI-first too: using AI to speed up document review, data analysis, customer communication, and project execution, while knowing exactly when human judgment is required. This one is not optional here.

RTA's biggest customers carry the most people, the most vehicles, and the most on the line if something falls through the cracks. You're the one making sure your whole team holds it together, from the first RFP question to the last go-live checklist item. Are you the reason it comes together instead of falling apart? Let's find out.

**This Role Probably Is Not for You if...**
-------------------------------------------

* You want to manage from a dashboard. You'll be in the RFPs, the escalation calls, and the data reviews alongside your team.
* You'd rather be the best implementer than build a team of them. Your success is measured by the team's go-lives, not your own.
* You avoid hard conversations. Holding a specialist accountable, or telling Sales that an RFP commitment isn't deliverable, is part of the job.
* You think contracts and RFPs are Sales' problem. If you'd rather find out what we promised at kickoff, this isn't your role.
* You want one team and one clear lane. This role coordinates Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM across every engagement, often all at once.
* You wait for someone else to flag risk. If a dependency or a specialist's portfolio is quietly stalling, naming it and building the mitigation plan is your job.
* You treat scope creep as a later problem. On accounts this size, an undocumented variation can turn into real financial or timeline exposure fast.
* You think using AI is cutting corners, or you're waiting for someone else to figure out how it fits your job. At RTA, that's not a personality quirk. It's a mismatch with the role.

**Key Results Areas (aka the Job Outcomes)**
--------------------------------------------

* Hit the agreed go-live date on at least 90% of the team's engagements each quarter, with at-risk timelines surfaced with a mitigation plan at least 2 weeks before they slip.
* Review 100% of enterprise RFPs, SOWs, and contracts for implementation commitments before submission or signature, returning comments to Sales within 3 business days.
* Zero signed enterprise commitments for implementation scope, timeline, or staffing that the team can't deliver as written.
* Maintain a customer satisfaction rating of 90% or higher across the team's completed implementations each quarter.
* Zero downstream data-quality escalations traced back to migration error, across the team.
* Log 100% of customer scope variations in the account record, escalating any that require an addendum within 2 business days of identification.
* Achieve 95% completion of internal implementation milestones on or before committed dates, so downstream teams receive clean, complete handoffs.
* Build and retain a high-performing team: low regrettable attrition, a documented development plan for every specialist, and new hires running implementations on their own within 90 days.
* Put at least one new AI-assisted workflow into practice across the team each quarter that measurably speeds up document review, data work, customer communication, or troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**
------------------

OK, the boring HR part of the job posting that looks like every other posting out there, but it's necessary:

* 7+ years in customer-facing implementation, onboarding, professional services, or project management roles; B2B SaaS (Software as a Service) strongly preferred
* 2+ years directly managing people, ideally a team of 4 or more implementers, consultants, or project managers
* Hands-on experience reviewing RFPs, SOWs, MSAs (Master Service Agreements), or similar contract documents for delivery scope and risk; public sector procurement experience a strong plus
* Track record leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise implementations from kickoff through go-live
* Proficient with Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint, with comfort in nested formulas, multi-condition logic, and multi-tab interconnected workbooks
* Experience with project/ticket tracking tools (e.g., JIRA) and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) tools (e.g., HubSpot)
* Comfortable leading conversations with senior fleet and operations leaders, including high-stakes configuration decisions and scope pushback
* Demonstrated, real-world use of AI tools to increase speed or accuracy in your own work and your team's, with specific examples you can speak to
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you write clearly enough that your redlines and comments don't need a follow-up meeting
* Fleet, fleet-adjacent, or public sector operations experience preferred, not required. We define this broadly:  
  + Direct fleet or asset operations: fleet manager, shop supervisor, maintenance coordinator, or municipal, school, and EMS fleet operations
  + Fleet-adjacent industries: transportation and logistics, public works, construction or utilities equipment, waste management
  + Fleet-adjacent software: implementation or onboarding experience with other fleet, asset, or maintenance management platforms
* Exposure to SQL (Structured Query Language) or structured databases preferred, not required
* Bachelor's degree not required. Relevant experience and breadth of knowledge matter more

Nick Fury never threw a punch. He assembled the team, coordinated the moving parts, and made sure everyone showed up in the right place at the right time. Think you can do that for an entire implementation team? Prove it.

**The Bottom Line**
-------------------

You've made it this far, congratulations. We're looking for an ideal team player with an almost frightening intensity around orchestration, credibility, and follow-through. That means someone who can build a team that holds six-team engagements together without losing sight of a single open item, and who catches the bad commitment in the RFP before it ever reaches the team. If you feel a quiet thrill when a complicated account lands exactly where it's supposed to, on time and without drama, and even more when your team lands it, we want to talk.

**Compensation & Work Location**
--------------------------------

* Total compensation for this role is between $120,000 and $135,000 based on experience.
* This is a full-time, fully remote-eligible role, including for candidates based in the Phoenix metro area.
* First week onboarding onsite at RTA HQ in Glendale, AZ required.
* Occasional visits to RTA HQ for team events should be expected.
* Travel to customer sites for pre-sales meetings, kickoffs, and go-lives is up to 10% annually, based on business needs.
* This position is classified as exempt and is not eligible for overtime pay.

**Why Top Talent Chooses RTA**
------------------------------

We invest in our people — period.

* 401(k) with 6% Safe Harbor match (100% vested day one)
* Flexible PTO model built on trust and manager-approved time off
* Cigna PPO and HSA medical plan options with company contributions ($780–$1,950 annually)
* Garner Health HRA program: up to $1,000 individual / $2,000 family reimbursement opportunity
* Wellness rewards up to $350 annually
* Virtual care and mental health support resources
* Company-sponsored benefits including dental, vision, EAP, life, STD, LTD, legal plan, and identity theft protection options
* Additional employee perks, wellness initiatives, and discount programs

**The Part We're Most Proud Of**
--------------------------------

* 99% of employees say RTA is a Great Place to Work® (Certified 3 years running)
* 30% ARR growth — two years straight
* We are an AI-forward company building for the future
* We see you. You have been reading this for seven minutes. Just apply already.

**About Us**
------------

RTA has been established since 1979 and has the reputation of providing the best customer service in the market. Our purpose is to help fleets succeed. We pride ourselves on creating a caring, family-oriented atmosphere for both staff and clients, and love that our work makes a positive impact on all the lives we touch. Our clients carry kids in school buses, first responders in emergency vehicles, patients in ambulances, food and medical supplies in trucks, and people just taking the bus or train to work. We do meaningful work, and we want our clients to have the best tools available to them.

Our office spaces are open, spacious, and colorful, with an abundance of natural light. We come together often as a company to enjoy freshly baked desserts or awesome lunches, and genuinely enjoy each other's company. We offer some pretty unique perks and benefits, as well as all the standard ones. We're happy to talk through all the options.

**Physical & Travel Requirements**
----------------------------------

* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods
* Ability to work at a computer for prolonged periods
* Ability to travel up to 10%
* Ability to travel to the company headquarters for Onboarding

**Heading to RTA HQ?**
----------------------

Coming from the east side? You'll enjoy waving at the traffic going the other way while never having to stare at the blinding sun. It only takes about 25 minutes to get here from downtown Scottsdale in the mornings. We are located close to Arrowhead Mall, with quick access to the 101 from multiple directions. If all of this sounds like you, and your type of company, then click apply. Seriously, we've asked you four times now, and you are still reading. Bonus points for being thorough.

**Reasonable Accommodation**
----------------------------

RTA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or perform the essential functions of this role, please notify us at hr@rtafleet.com.

**Employment Notices**
----------------------

Employment with RTA is at-will. This means either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Employment with RTA may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check and other pre-employment screenings, consistent with applicable law.

 **A Brief Overview**  
  
The EHR Application Principal Trainer - Pharmacist is an Information Technology role responsible for designing, developing, validating, maintaining, and delivering role-based application training for assigned electronic health record (EHR) and healthcare information system applications. This role partners with informatics analysts, operational leaders, subject matter experts, and the system-wide learning team as appropriate to ensure training curriculum, workflow scenarios, course assignments, and training environments accurately reflect approved system configuration, role-based access, operational workflows, and release changes for all phases of medication management and closed-loop processes. This role does not own system level learning strategy, leadership development, general employee development, onboarding, compliance education, or non-EHR education programs.  
  
**What you will do**  

* Develop and maintain application curriculum: • Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve role-based application training curriculum, lesson plans, workflow scenarios, tip sheets, job aids, exercises, eLearning content, and supporting materials for assigned EHR and healthcare information system applications, addressing all phases of medication management and closed-loop medication processes.
* Support application change control and release readiness : • Participate in application workgroups, change control discussions, upgrade planning, release reviews, testing activities, and optimization initiatives to identify training impacts and update curriculum prior to implementation.
* Analyze roles and training assignments: • Analyze end-user roles, application access, workflows, and training requirements to maintain application-specific course catalogs and support appropriate training assignments.
* Coordinate curriculum review and approval: • Facilitate curriculum review with subject matter experts, informatics application teams, and operational stakeholders to confirm workflow accuracy and obtain required approvals before implementation.
* Build, test, and maintain training environments.: • Build, validate, test, maintain, and troubleshoot training environments, training patients, exercises, and scenario data in partnership with informatics analysts and environment support teams.
* Deliver application training: • Deliver instructor-led, virtual, recorded, and targeted one-on-one application training for end users, super users, application training partners, and internal staff for assigned EHR and healthcare information systems applications.
* Evaluate training effectiveness: • Review learner feedback, assessment results, help desk trends, workflow issues, and stakeholder input to identify training gaps and implement continuous improvements to curriculum, materials, and delivery methods.

* Prepare training delivery readiness: • Prepare training materials, training records, classroom or virtual delivery tools, and required technology to support effective learning experiences. • Partner with system-wide learning resources when system-level learning platforms, templates, or reporting are required.
